name: genpark-agentic-multimodal-invoice-receipt-reconciler-skill
description: Autonomous Multi-Modal Invoice & Receipt Reconciler. Parses structured financial receipts, invoices, and bank statements, performs tolerance-based three-way reconciliation, detects tax calculation drift and duplicate claims, and synthesizes double-entry bookkeeping journal entries.

tools.name: reconcile_invoice_receipt
tools.description: Extract financial metadata, verify VAT/sales tax calculations, reconcile invoices against bank transaction feeds, and synthesize double-entry journal entries.

invoice_data.description: Invoice payload with vendor, total, tax, currency, and line items.
